notes: The page writes a presentation for dotted quotient generators and a presentation for their lifts sigma_0,sigma_1,sigma_infinity,rho,tau_0,tau_1,tau_infinity. A diagonal left note asks for the rho-sigma conjugation relations and also calls them consequences of the adjacent relations. A separate left note identifies three tilded sigmas. The bracketed right note gives l_0=tau_infinity tau_1, l_1=tau_0 tau_infinity and l_infinity=tau_1 tau_0, after crossed-out starts, and calls the product relation automatic. The lower-right verb is unresolved in the ink; the mathematical plausibility of either interpretation was not used to supply letters. The canceled final question was revised by the author with On peut and par l’une des before being canceled with the whole paragraph. The singular or plural endings of dernier/groupe remain narrow doubts. The two opening elements words remain ambiguous compressed forms, and the initial rho’s dot is inseparable from retracing. The bottom pagination is 29. No independent algebraic or group-presentation verification was performed by this reader; these are transcription observations, not a proof check. The main reader separately checked the narrow assertion that l_infinity l_1 l_0 is automatic: substituting the displayed definitions cancels the adjacent tau_0 pair, then tau_infinity pair, then tau_1 pair, using the displayed involution relations. This confirms that identity only. No broader group-presentation claim was independently proved.
